name: Will a second-story addition disrupt my daily life?

mainEntity.name: Will a second-story addition disrupt my daily life?

acceptedAnswer.text: While any major construction project involves some disruption, we strive to minimize its impact on your daily life. Our team implements strategies like establishing clear work zones, maintaining a clean site, and scheduling noisy activities at appropriate times. In some cases, temporary relocation might be recommended during intensive phases like roofing or utility tie-ins, but often, residents can remain in their homes with proper planning and communication.
acceptedAnswer.description: Some disruption is expected, but we minimize it through careful planning and communication. Temporary relocation may be advised during intensive phases.
